services.desc: Looking for a jet ski rental in Toronto without the downtown crowds? A&M Watersports offers high-quality 2026 jet skis from Keswick on Lake Simcoe, a popular water destination for riders coming from Toronto, the GTA, Newmarket, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Markham, Barrie, and surrounding areas. Enjoy clean open water, newer machines, safety equipment, simple online booking, and an easy day-trip experience just north of Toronto. Rentals start at $95/hour, and you only need a $50 booking deposit to reserve your spot online. Many people searching for jet ski rental Toronto want more than the closest rental.
